system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Bakery mutual exclusion algorithm. It extends the Bakery specification and overrides the natural number type with a finite range to make the state space finite and amenable to exhaustive model checking.
actors_and_components: Same as the Bakery specification: N concurrent processes competing for mutual exclusion. This module adds a constant for the upper bound on natural numbers used during model checking.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the Bakery specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the Bakery specification, but with natural numbers restricted to a finite range from 0 to the configured maximum.
actions: Inherits all actions from the Bakery specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the Bakery specification: mutual exclusion (no two processes in the critical section simultaneously), type correctness, and the full inductive invariant.
model_bounds: N is set to 2 processes. The maximum natural number value is set to 2. The infinite set of natural numbers is overridden with the finite range 0 through the maximum value. The specification used is the inductive specification (starting from arbitrary type-correct states satisfying the invariant rather than only from the initial state). Deadlock checking is disabled.
additional_assumptions: This module is designed for model checking only. It overrides the natural number type globally, replacing the infinite set with a finite range, which constrains ticket numbers to the specified maximum. The inductive specification is used to verify that the invariant is preserved by all transitions from any reachable state.
